author: Marialzini

title: UI really annoying
body:
The visual display of time is excellent. The UI for creating a timer and reusing a timer is really really annoying.
I have a one minute timer - says time is up all the time- have to press reset and play lots of time to make it go again. They are too near the bottom of the screen on an XS max - don’t reliably work.
Why the developers think you want to go away from the App from a day and come back to see ‘Time is Up’ on a timer you watched finish is beyond me.
Also when it beeps no easy way to cancel noise quickly.

Needs work
author: Narcoleptoc

title: Excellent App. Recommended it! 😃👍🏻
body:
I am really enjoying this app, it is really helpful as a timer specially for studying:
it let me realize when 1 hour has gone while I am studying so I can be more focused and be more productive.

The only thing I would add is the possibility to move the timers position, because it could be handy when you have several timers.

Thank you 😀
